answer: Verified Uptime Attestation uses sustained participation as the scarce resource. Each identity must present a continuous signed heartbeat chain; any gap larger than an ember-sized interval resets accumulated standing to zero. Creating a new identity forfeits all prior standing, so an attacker must spend real elapsed time re-earning trust per identity rather than paying once. The verification kernel rejects chains lacking cross-node timing witnesses from a rotating oasis of independent validators.
